title: MoonAtlas review
description: What one blind Reviewer found checking claims: a verdict per claim, with the lines that decide it.

doc_defects.description: A page or comment the review found saying what the code does not, as path:line and what the code does.

notes.description: What was skipped or left uncertain, and why.

verdict.description: correct: every part of the sentence holds. partly: a part holds and a part does not. wrong: its central statement does not hold.

cites_support.description: Whether the cited lines or section show the fact.

home_ok.description: Whether the claim's home is right; null when the review did not check it.

reason.description: The lines that decide the verdict, as path:line.

entry.description: A verdict on one claim, named by its claims file in the same folder, without .json, and its id.
